key_terms.ذَكَرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ: Mentioning or invoking the name of God (saying Bismillah) at the moment of releasing the hunting weapon, a required condition for the permissibility of game
key_terms.صَيْد: Hunted prey or game; the act and product of hunting
key_terms.مِعْرَاض: A blunt wooden stick or flat-headed arrow used for hunting that kills by blunt force rather than by cutting; its use in hunting has specific jurisprudential conditions
key_terms.نَبْل: Pointed arrow or any sharp-tipped projectile used in hunting, which is the standard instrument for lawful game hunting

ai.seo_question: Is game killed by a blunt hunting weapon (mi'rad) permissible to eat in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) was asked about the permissibility of consuming game killed by a mi'rad — a blunt, non-pointed stick or flat-headed weapon used in hunting. The Imam ruled that if the hunter has no pointed weapon other than the mi'rad and invoked God's name over it, the kill is permissible to eat. However, if the hunter possessed a pointed arrow and chose the mi'rad instead, the kill is not permissible. This ruling reflects the Islamic principle that game must be killed by a cutting/pointed instrument that causes proper slaughter, and the mi'rad is only permitted when it is the sole available weapon.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having been asked about what the blunt weapon knocks down from the hunted prey. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If there does not happen to be an arrow for it apart from the crushing, and the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Mentioned over it, so let him eat what is killed’. I said, ‘Supposing there happens to be an arrow apart from it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Once abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

was asked about the prey that falls because of flareless arrow. He (the Imam) said, ‘If he does not have any other arrow and has mentioned the name of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, he can use it for food. If he has other arrows then he cannot use it for food.’”
